change_summary: No spec changes needed; the inline comment about setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in env is acknowledged but does not contradict the ticket requirements or existing specs.

addressed.change: The comment notes that ANTHROPIC_API_KEY can be set later in env if not already set. This aligns with the existing spec: AC3 already specifies that MissingAPIKeyError is raised when the key is unset, and .env.example already documents ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= as required. No spec revision needed; the implementation will handle the env var lookup at runtime as designed.
